focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of text (titles, prices, credits).

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. In real photos, even blurry text usually retains character structure. If the auditor finds 'alien' glyphs or melting letters, this is a strong signal of AI generation. Also, check if the rack wires maintain consistent thickness and depth ordering relative to the comics.
